title: Concerto No. 1
identity: Donemus identifies Hanna Kulenty's Saxophone Concerto No. 1 for alto saxophone and symphony orchestra, composed in 2015 and lasting about 22 minutes. The publisher provides a 52-page watermark preview from a 108-page score; four opening pages were inspected; the opening score pages identify the score as concert pitch and say the solo saxophone is amplified with delay.

evidence.claim: Donemus identifies the 2015 concerto for alto saxophone and symphony orchestra, duration 22:00, with a 108-page full score.
A University of Pretoria thesis abstract indexes the concerto as 2015 and gives 26:04, illustrating a duration discrepancy without establishing a different edition.
Public Donemus preview pages 1–4 were visually inspected; page 2 lists score in C, amplified saxophone with delay, and interpretation notes for dynamics and slurs.
Composer’s news post documents the 2016 premiere, saxophonist Alina Mleczko, Warsaw Philharmonic, conductor Michał Dworzyński, and a composer-linked recording.
Composer concert archive lists further performances in Warsaw in April 2016 and Nizhny Novgorod in June 2018.

score_observations: On preview p. 2, the publisher states the notation is in C and the solo saxophone is amplified with delay, so the displayed pitches should not be treated as a transposed alto part. The opening solo line on p. 3 uses short note groups alternating with long tied notes, dynamic changes from very soft to very loud, and several changing meters including 3/4, 2/8, and 2/4. Preview p. 4 shows dense piano/keyboard chords against sustained ensemble tones, a more active solo saxophone figure, and a marked glissando. Only opening preview pages were inspected; no complete solo range claim is made.
review_focus: Inference from the inspected opening: coordinate amplification/delay, changing meter, wide dynamic contrast, and the shift from sustained to more active writing; examine the full score for later textures and complete range.
collection_flag: Orchestral concert work; no school-level or college-syllabus evidence found in this search pass.

listening.description: Composer page links a performance of Saxophone Concerto No. 1.
listening.verification: The link was extracted from the composer’s official page; direct video metadata could not be retrieved and playback was not audited.

score_links.description: Public watermarked preview of Donemus product 14817; only pp. 1–4 visually inspected.

gaps: Only four opening pages of the 52-page public preview (for the 108-page full score) were inspected; later sections and full solo range remain unexamined.
A University of Pretoria repository result lists 26:04, while Donemus states about 22 minutes; the duration basis/version is unresolved.
The composer-linked recording has not been auditioned and its video metadata could not be retrieved directly.
